Final preregistration for the LUNA671-derived fixed-keystream substitution test. Source and control bytes are frozen; no Rev7 target run yet. Root reviewed the driver and passed its preflight (8384ce); independent mathematical audit and 30 planted full-chain shuffled-map controls pass.

Run 780 orientation-labelled contexts: 19 block primitives x full-block OFB/custom-CTR x Zombies/ZOMBIES x NUL/ascii0 IV x 5 canonical orientations =760, plus Panama/Arcfour x2keys x5orientations =20. The block-mode recurrence is source-supported. For the20 stream cells, the source capture lacks underlying algorithm modules, so the fixed-XOR law remains empirically supported by full-length probes and its universal conclusion is conditional on that model. Enigma and WAKE fail the law and are excluded. This does not include OFB8.

For an arbitrary inverse glyph map g, P[i]=byte(g(high),g(low)) XOR K[i]. A necessary ASCII high nibble is in H={0,2,3,4,5,6,7}. Record W[a,v]=number of high-glyph a positions with v XOR high(K[i]) in H. Every possible g has ASCIIcount <= sum_a max_v W[a,v]. At546bytes, >=75% requires410allowed bytes. Any upper bound <410 proves no mapping passes; otherwise report unresolved unless the separately sound pair bound decides it. A100%-ASCII CSP failure will not be mislabeled a75% exclusion. This is an algebraic bound covering all16! bijections, not that many individual decryptions.

Retain full keystream bytes, all16x16matrices, bounds, exact descriptors, prior overlap by actual stream hash/orientation, and any full-ASCII witnesses. Run once, then use the independent saved-result verifier without crypto/search replay. Existing72+24strict-OFB cells remain prior coverage; the result will label overlaps. No unknown-key, IV, feedback-mode or arbitrary-multilayer conclusion.
